description.value: The Tournament Capital Centre is Kamloops' flagship municipal recreation facility, operated by the City of Kamloops and offering aquatics, skating, and multi-sport programming. Its name reflects Kamloops' long-standing identity as a tournament-hosting city, and the centre regularly draws athletes and events from across the province. Touring cyclists passing through Kamloops will find it a prominent public facility near the city core.
